breakdowns.sentence: Growing up without money in my family, but still being able to travel from Mexico to Thailand to Portugal, Brazil, and beyond, all by myself.
breakdowns.translation: 我在家裡沒有錢的情況下長大，但仍然能夠從墨西哥到泰國到葡萄牙、巴西等等。

points.label: to 不定詞
points.note: 表示目的或補充前面的動作。

breakdowns.sentence: I only knew that I could teach a couple of English lessons and keep going.
breakdowns.translation: 有時我不知道自己要住哪裡。

points.label: that 子句
points.note: 用 that 補充說明前面的想法或內容。

breakdowns.sentence: So, someone asked me in the comments, "What do you think you would be if you weren't an English teacher?"

points.label: would 假設語氣
points.note: 用 would 表示假設情境或想像中的結果。

breakdowns.sentence: If this speed is too slow for you, then just speed up the video.
breakdowns.translation: 於是，有人在評論裡問我，

points.label: if 條件句
points.note: 用條件說明可能情況與結果。

breakdowns.sentence: And when my sister turned 18 years old, she became an English teacher as well.
breakdowns.translation: 如果這個速度對你來說太慢了。

points.label: when 時間子句
points.note: 說明事件發生的時間點或背景。

breakdowns.sentence: She made a good salary, good money, and she was able to pay for her food and rent in college with that job.

points.label: be able to 能力句型
points.text: be + able + to + 原形動詞
points.note: 表示有能力或有機會做到某事。
